1.why: Physics and biology are my favorite subjects but math only came up at a basic level during school.

3.why: Geometry and angles were not my favorite subjects and I struggle to visualize missing angles in diagrams.

4.why: Algebra is one of the subjects I disliked during school and I feel I lack confidence solving equations now.

7.why: Sketching curves requires advanced math skills and I have no confidence in drawing or analyzing complex curves.

8.why: Fractions are common in cooking and everyday tasks so I can manage them but complex fraction math is hard.

9.why: Finding missing side lengths involves geometry which was not a favorite subject and I feel unsure about it.
